desc:
👋 Welcome to Toy Trains! 🚂

🚂 Drive colorful wooden toy trains on a giant map with wooden toy tracks!
🛤️ Change your track direction/route by clicking a button!
🤗 Play alone or with friends!
🏆 Can you reach the Golden Trophy at the end of the track?

[ LATEST UPDATE - 4/21/26 ]
- NEW LIMITED TIME TRAIN - Long Metro Train 🚂⏰
- Added NEW City area to the game! 📍
- New AFK Anti-track blocker system! ⚙️
- Train speed increased: 27 > 35 📈
- New Coins/Wins purchasable only Trains! 💵
- New music on the music playlist! 🔊
- GUI improvements ⚙️
- Multiple Bug Fixes. 🐛
